text:
Annie: paging — billing telemetry alert: sudden surge in token tallies for EU region, multiple overage flags firing.
metering-bot: [ALERT] token emission anomaly detected: source=emitter-proxy, window=03:12-03:18 UTC, pct_change=+1200%.
Raj: oncall here, joining. What’s the blast radius?
Annie: initial list: acct:AC-412, AC-733, AC-998. Internal logs show replayed batches from proxy. Some duplicates appear in aggregation.
Mike: flipping emitter into safe-forward mode now to stop retries: `systemctl restart emitter --args "--mode=safe-forward"`
Lina: suppressing customer overage notifications for impacted accounts (temp rule). CS notified to hold outreach.
Raj: running quick dedupe check:
```
SELECT count(*) FROM tokens_agg
WHERE window = '2026-06-14T03:12:00Z'
AND source = 'emitter-proxy';
```
Results showing duplicate segment hashes.
ops-bot: Incident created INC-2026-145 — billing telemetry surge (severity: auto).
Mike: safe-forward applied, incoming rate dropping. Still seeing ~3x residual duplicates while replays drain.
Annie: customer impact: two enterprise customers had overage flags and received automated notice drafts. Billing team paused invoice automation for the window.
Lina: CS-Lead, pls confirm hold on manual outreach until we have reconciled counts. I DM'd you.
CS-Lead: saw DM, will hold. Thanks.
Raj: root cause hypothesis — emitter retry logic requeued previously-acked batches when partial ack returned 500; no idempotency key check on requeue.
Annie: mitigation plan: 1) keep emitter in safe-forward 2) run dedupe reprocess for 03:12-03:20 window 3) temporary suppression of overage notifications 4) generate reconciliation report for affected accounts. ETA ~90m.
metering-bot: Reconciliation job started -> job_id=job-92348.
Mike: reprocess finished: gross delta reduced from +12x to +1.14x after dedupe. Preparing sanitized counts for billing.
Lina: Confirmed billing automation still paused. No invoices issued.
Annie: Ops note: we pushed a hotfix to emitter to add idempotency check on requeue (patch: emitter#987). Rolling to canary now.
Raj: will draft post-incident notes and action items. Need to add an integration test to simulate partial ack + retry.
Annie: assigning follow-ups: Mike -> permanent fix rollout; Raj -> postmortem; Lina -> update notification playbook; CS-Lead -> customer comms once reconciled.
ops-bot: INC-2026-145 severity downgraded to Sev3; mitigation in place.
Annie: closing check-in — counts reconciled to within expected variance, billing paused during window, CS on hold. Postmortem to follow. :thumbsup:
Raj: noted. I'll own the write-up.
__notes: Thread created to capture on-call coordination for billing telemetry surge; structured as single continuous Slack thread string per agents.md.
